description: Two figures side by side, each with its own caption directly beneath it, and now a synthetic `graphics` Image entry over each figure's bbox -- the scenario the checklist calls out as most at risk of a caption being associated with the wrong figure. graphics::detect_picture_regions (Stage 1b) now emits a separate Picture region per Image graphic, so both figures classify correctly; there is still no *association* step linking a Caption to a specific nearby Picture region (needed once two figures' captions could plausibly be swapped), which is what this case continues to seed geometry for.
